Select compounds tested against human P2X7 purinoceptor (CHEMBL4805) with IC50 activities in nM. Return only rows where the compound has a canonical SMILES and the activity has a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Include assay description, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
